experienceProfile.rawText: About Hexnode   Hexnode is a  global leader in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) , trusted by over 100 countries and managing millions of devices worldwide. With a rapid pace of innovation,  we have  established ourselves as a dominant force across Apple, Windows, Android, mac OS, Linux, and tv OS.   Why Hexnode?   Hexnode is a rare combination of global scale, product excellence, and startup-level velocity. We operate in a mission-critical category-supporting organizations that rely on secure, reliable device management every single day.   Joining Hexnode means stepping into a company in hyper-growth mode. With millions of devices under management and 100+ annual feature releases, you will have the opportunity to shape the next phase of a category-defining platform .   Role   We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to lead our PMM team and own the end-to-end PLG ecosystem. If you’re an expert at translating deep technical capabilities into persuasive narratives and using data to crush friction points, join us and help us shape the future of Unified Endpoint Management.   Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end launch lifecycle. Ensure all content-from whitepapers to in-app tooltips-is persona-specific, persuasive, and technically accurate.   Directly manage a team of Product Marketing Leads and PLG specialists. You will be responsible for their professional development, quality of output, and cross-functional alignment.   Partner with Product Management and Engineering to route NPS data and customer feedback into the roadmap, ensuring Hexnode remains a customer-centric platform.     Required  Experience & Expertise   8-12 years in Product Marketing, with a significant portion dedicated to B2B Saa S.   Proven experience in a team lead or people management capacity.   Deep expertise in Product-Led Growth, including hands-on experience with product analytics and in-app communication strategies.   Highly proficient in data interpretation.
